effects.text: Choose Acid, Cold, Fire or Lightning: your firearms deal that type until their next reload.

description.public:
Gadget · Engineer invention powered by Toolbelt scraps. Activate for 1 scrap; spend a 2nd scrap for the Toolbelt effect. Only Engineers gain the active benefit — an ally given this gadget gains only the Passive.

Free Action (1 scrap): Reload your firearms. Until their next reload, they deal your choice of Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage.

Toolbelt (2 scraps): Attacks deal +STR damage of the same type, ignoring armor.

Passive: Firearms have +1 Ammo.

[A] Using the gadget spends 1 Toolbelt scrap — tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[A] Reloads every firearm you carry (refills their Ammo counters; a firearm you don't own shows "no change").

[A] The Toolbelt upgrade is the separate "Elemental Munition (Toolbelt)" feature (2 scraps total); the passive lives on the "Elemental Munition" gadget feature, so it works even if this item is unequipped.

[A] Keep the gadget equipped: Nimble switches off an unequipped object's rules, so its scrap cost would not be charged.

[M] Change the damage type of your firearm attacks yourself until the next reload.
